subject: fitting beta distribution from CDF observations

messages.author: e1c430550f86b1f6
messages.subject: fitting beta distribution from CDF observations
parts:
Hi all,

Maybe it's not entirely a STAN question.

I wonder what is the best way to fit/recover the parameters of a beta distribution when given observation of the CDF?

For example, let's say I have a series of beta CDF observation generated:

data{
  real a;
  real b;
}

model {}

generated quantities {
  real x;
  real cdf_x;

  x <- uniform_rng (0, 1);
  cdf_x <- beta_cdf(x, a, b);
}

Now, when given, the series of x and cdf_x, how can i recover a and b?

Many thanks!

Andy
